# Jason's Glass Tint

> Window tinting in San Clemente, California, since 1989. Owner Jason Ewell personally installs every job (no subcontractors): car, truck and SUV tint, home and office window film, commercial storefront film, boat (marine) tint, RV tint, frosted privacy film, and safety/security film. Serves San Clemente, Talega, Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, Ladera Ranch, Rancho Mission Viejo, Camp Pendleton and South Orange County.

- Phone / text: (949) 496-8468 (texting Jason a photo is the fastest way to get a quote)
- Address: 23 Via Conocido, San Clemente, CA 92673
- Google rating: 4.7 out of 5 from 35 reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=10756109855489898423
- Website: https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/

## Services
- [Automotive window tint](https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/automotive-window-tint): cars, trucks, SUVs, sports cars; heat and UV rejection; California-legal shades
- [Residential window tint](https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/residential-window-tint): heat, glare, UV fade protection and privacy for homes
- [Commercial window tint](https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/commercial-window-tint): offices, storefronts, conference rooms
- [Marine window tint](https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/marine-window-tint): boats and yachts
- [Frost / privacy film](https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/frost-film): bathrooms, office glass, doors
- [Safety and security film](https://www.jasonsglasstint.com/safety-film): shatter resistance
